title: QUESTIONNAIRES — Dietary
description: Meat, fish, fruit, vegetable and tea consumption, and changes in diet as a result of giving blood, from the questionnaire.
$comment: The source gives no 999 for most items here (only meatEater and ageVeg).

weekly_times.$comment: Source codes: 0 = do not eat it, 0.1 = less than once a week, 1 - 20 = times / week, 777 = more than 20 times per week. The source gives no 999 for these items. Whole numbers assumed for 1 - 20 because the fractional value 0.1 is listed as its own code (D024).

meatEater.title: Do you eat meat or fish?

ageVeg.title: How old were you when you last ate any kind of meat or fish (vegetarians only)?
ageVeg.$comment: Source wording: '(vegetarians only)' (R001). The dictionary gives no value for people outside that universe, so no rule is enforced (D024). Whole years assumed for 1 - 70 (D024).

liver.title: In an average week how many times do you eat liver (any type e.g. pigs, chicken, lambs)?

redMeat.title: In an average week how many times do you eat red meat (e.g. beef, lamb, pork, bacon, ham, sausages, burgers)?

poultry.title: In an average week how many times do you eat poultry (e.g. chicken, turkey)?

whiteFish.title: In an average week how many times do you eat White fish (e.g. cod, haddock, tinned tuna)?

oilyFish.title: In an average week how many times do you eat oily fish (canned or fresh e.g. sardines, mackerel, salmon, trout)?

veg.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume vegetables (excluding potatoes)

fruit.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit (whole)

juice.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit juice

smooth.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit smoothies

tea.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume tea
